rules.title: Exchange rate used
rules.statement_sr: Za potrebe knjigovodstva i statistike primenjuje se zvanični srednji kurs dinara.
rules.statement_en: For bookkeeping, the official NBS middle rate of the dinar applies.

sources.title: Zakon o deviznom poslovanju ("Sl. glasnik RS" 62/2006 ... 19/2025)
Kurs API documentation (data from the National Bank of Serbia)
sources.quote: HTTP JSON API to get information on Serbian Dinar currency exchange rates based on official data from National Bank of Serbia

rules.title: Which date's rate
rules.statement_sr: Koristi se srednji kurs na dan izdavanja fakture.
rules.statement_en: A foreign-currency invoice is converted at the NBS middle rate on its issue date.

sources.title: Unija: KPO knjiga, kako se vodi i ko je vodi
sources.quote: uvek se koristi zvaničan srednji kurs dinara na dan prometa dobara i usluga

rules.note: One source says the date of supply. When an invoice states the same issue and supply date, both readings agree.

rules.title: Days with no new rate
rules.statement_sr: Za dan za koji NBS ne objavljuje kurs koristi se poslednji objavljeni kurs.
rules.statement_en: On weekends and holidays, when NBS publishes no new rate, the most recent published rate is used. Both the requested date and the rate date are shown.

sources.title: Kurs API documentation (data from the National Bank of Serbia)
sources.quote: If the rate is not published ... rate from the last known day will be used for that day.

sources.title: National Bank of Serbia: The dinar exchange rate
sources.quote: the NBS also publishes the official middle exchange rate of the dinar against the euro, applicable from 8 a.m. next business day

rules.note: The NBS publishes on business days only. No official text read here states in words which rate a weekend takes.

rules.title: Rounding
rules.statement_sr: Iznos u dinarima se zaokružuje na dve decimale (pola naviše).
rules.statement_en: The RSD amount is rounded to two decimals, half up.

sources.title: Zakon o deviznom poslovanju ("Sl. glasnik RS" 62/2006 ... 19/2025)

rules.note: No source states the rounding convention.
